critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx had a duplicate import of `ClipboardCheck`, `Activity`, `MessageSquare`, `ShieldAlert` on the new line 10. This is a webpack build-blocking SyntaxError ('Identifier "ClipboardCheck" has already been declared'). Whenever appending new lucide icons to an existing import block, dedupe against the prior lines. I fixed this in this iteration.

rca of the issue: BLOCKER: Frontend webpack compile failed with 'Identifier ClipboardCheck has already been declared' at Layout.jsx:10:76. Root cause: when Phase 3 added a new line of icon imports to /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx, four icons that were already imported earlier (ClipboardCheck on line 8, Activity on line 7, MessageSquare on line 8, ShieldAlert on line 4) were re-listed on line 10. ECMAScript forbids duplicate import bindings → SyntaxError → Babel parse failure → webpack-dev-server served the error overlay instead of the app → every route (including /login) showed the red 'Compiled with problems' overlay. Reproduction: open the preview URL — entire app blank with red Babel error. Mitigation applied: removed the four duplicates from line 10, keeping the unique new icons (FileSignature, History, SettingsIcon, Network, CalendarRange, Ruler, AlertTriangle, PlusSquare). Frontend recompiled cleanly via HMR; login + all routes recovered.
